title: GitHub Projects v2 backlog export row
description: Schema for one row of analysis/handoff/backlog_export_github.csv produced by bsa-backlog-bridge (Phase 3, US-S9-03). GitHub Projects v2 has no native bulk CSV import; the bridge emits a CSV that an operator-side script or GitHub Actions workflow consumes to (1) `gh issue create` an underlying issue, then (2) `gh project item-create` + `gh project item-edit` to associate it with a Project v2 board and set its custom-field values. (No bridge-shipped script today — operator owns the import driver. Future v1.2+ candidate: ship a sample `scripts/github_projects_import.sh` per [TODO-S9-03-IMPORT-DRIVER].) Column set mirrors Linear (TODO-S9-03-GITHUB-PROJECTS, closed in v1.1.4) with two GitHub-specific additions: Body (markdown body the issue carries — Linear uses Description, GitHub APIs use Body) + Size (Project v2 single-select 'Size' field; XS/S/M/L/XL convention). Strictly read-only with respect to canonical state. Schema-enforced via F5 dispatcher entry under analysis/handoff/backlog_export_github.csv.

Title.description: GitHub issue title. Sourced from A70.Title. GitHub allows titles up to 256 chars; A70 caps at 120 so this column inherits that ceiling.

Body.description: GitHub Markdown body. A70.StoryText followed by an 'Acceptance criteria' bulleted list, then a BSA provenance footer (StoryID + SourceClaimIDs + RelatedNFRIDs). GitHub renders Markdown natively.

Status.description: GitHub Projects v2 'Status' single-select option. Bridge defaults to 'Backlog' for INVEST-deferred stories (INVESTStatus != 'pass') and 'Todo' for INVEST-pass stories. 'In Progress' / 'Done' are accepted in the schema for round-trip but the bridge never emits them (downstream tooling owns lifecycle post-import).

Priority.description: GitHub Projects v2 'Priority' single-select option. Maps from A70.Priority: level-1 → P1, level-2 → P2, level-3 → P3. P0 reserved for operator post-import escalation (bridge never emits P0 — that's a manual sponsor decision via A51, not a derived export shape).

Size.description: GitHub Projects v2 'Size' single-select option. Maps from A70.EstimationHint verbatim (xs/s/m/l/xl uppercased; unknown → empty string). Empty string is the explicit 'no hint' value.

Labels.description: Comma-separated GitHub issue labels. Same regex as Linear: 3 positive + 3 negative lookaheads enforce EXACTLY ONE 'bsa-export' tag + EXACTLY ONE 'level-N' tier + EXACTLY ONE 'invest-N' tier. Per-tag character class is GitHub-label-friendly (lowercase + alphanumeric + hyphen + underscore). Operators may add extra labels post-import.

StoryID.description: Provenance: A70.StoryID. The operator-side import script can place this in a 'BSA Story' Project v2 text field for back-traceability into canonical.

SourceClaimIDs.description: Provenance: A70.SourceClaimIDs verbatim. Empty allowed when RelatedNFRIDs is non-empty (mirrors A70 INV-08).

RelatedNFRIDs.description: Provenance: A70.RelatedNFRIDs verbatim. Empty allowed when SourceClaimIDs is non-empty.

x-bsa-csv-columns-order._comment: Canonical column order for diff stability. GitHub-import-required columns first (Title, Body), then Project v2 single-select fields (Status, Priority, Size, Labels), then BSA provenance (StoryID, SourceClaimIDs, RelatedNFRIDs).

x-bsa-provenance-rules._comment: INV-08 carries through to the export — every row MUST carry non-empty SourceClaimIDs OR RelatedNFRIDs (mirrors A70 schema's same-named extension). Reuses the generalized _apply_provenance_rules handler in write_validator.py — same hook-time enforcement as Linear and generic exports.
x-bsa-provenance-rules.rationale: An export row with both provenance fields empty would be a backlog item the consumer can't trace back to a claim or NFR — defeats the whole point of the bridge. Schema-enforced at write time so a bridge bug emitting empty provenance fails the F5 hook.
